activity_text.M1: M1 exact-read Controller+Executor mailbox. Classify CLEAR/PENDING/WAIT/CONFLICT/BLOCKED.
activity_text.M2: M2 validate protocol, cursor, continuation, base/SHA/scope/artifacts and deadlock predicate.
activity_text.M3: M3 when PENDING/WAIT run read-only Red Team mailbox validation; run Analyzer only after Controller declares a typed read-only child contract—otherwise record ANALYZER_NOT_DECLARED.
activity_text.M4: M4 if reviews conflict with Controller or block workflow, use one bound Controller exchange to reconcile; do not mint authority.
activity_text.M5: M5 execute one clear typed authorized action only.
activity_text.M6: M6 independently verify exact artifacts/validators/repository or remote evidence.
activity_text.M7: M7 patch/readback the single Executor mailbox and send one bound Controller notification when canonical protocol allows; report G1–G6.
